profile_text.body:
Stack AI describes itself as a platform for enterprises to deploy AI agents at scale. According to its site, it offers a drag-and-drop no-code platform for building secure, compliant AI applications, and it says agents built on the platform can read, write, and execute tasks within existing systems through more than 500 enterprise integrations. The company states that its platform supports AI transformation and adoption across a range of industries and enterprises.

The site presents Stack AI as a no-code AI app builder with enterprise deployment, workflow automation, and data connector governance. It includes customer statements about building AI assistants for students in a matter of weeks without coding, testing, deploying, and managing a range of agents, and supporting governance, validation, and oversight in a highly regulated environment, where one customer describes the platform as serving as a catalyst in a bank's growth story.

The available material does not include litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records for Stack AI.
